text:
Situation: Metoprolol succinate supply is constrained after Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. posted a discontinuation on 2026-08-31. Corvale East holds 161 units of 25 mg tablets (18.7 days) and Corvale General holds 393.76 units (28.6 days). Metoprolol tartrate stock remains adequate at both sites.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records that Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. posted a discontinuation of metoprolol succinate on 2026-08-31 with a business decision to discontinue manufacture. NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (FEI 3003294404) last inspection was NAI on 2025-03-12; its history includes VAI classifications from 2010 through 2020 and a Warning Letter on 2019-09-27. Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) last inspection was VAI on 2026-07-16; its history includes an OAI classification in 2009, a Warning Letter in 2010, and subsequent VAI inspections through 2026.

Our position: Current succinate inventory covers approximately 19 to 29 days depending on site. No alternative supplier on the ranked list discloses a manufacturing plant we can verify. Tartrate formulations are not affected by the Teva discontinuation.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to contact each ranked supplier (A-S Medication Solutions, ASCLEMED USA INC., Actavis Pharma, Inc., Advagen Pharma Limited, Advagen Pharma Ltd) and request the registered manufacturing or repack plant name and FEI for verification; buyer approves purchase after verification.
2. Buyer to confirm allocation limits and lead times with any verified supplier; pharmacy director approves order placement.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for new postings or status changes; pharmacy director receives weekly summary.

Not recommended: Switching patients to metoprolol tartrate or adjusting doses without a formal therapeutic interchange protocol approved by the P&T committee and treating clinicians.
